result.question: Comprehensive market analysis of Telegram bots for prediction markets, with focus on (1) Kalshi trading bots/integrations on Telegram, and (2) Hyperliquid prediction market trading bots on Telegram (Hyperliquid launched its own prediction market ~May 2026). Cover: who the major players are, which are growing/doing well (user counts, volume, revenue, funding where available), their features and differentiators, business models, and the broader landscape of crypto/prediction-market trading bots on Telegram (e.g. Polymarket bots, Banana Gun, Trojan, BONKbot style trading bots adapted to perps/prediction markets). I am building a Telegram bot for Kalshi whose differentiator is: AI does deep research to find picks; it surfaces predictions made on podcasts and ties them to real tradable markets; and it lets users execute trades directly from Telegram with one click. Assess whether this is genuinely differentiated vs. what exists, identify gaps/whitespace, and give go-to-market recommendations.
result.summary: Not whitespace on venues; rivals do copy/social trading. AI-research + podcast-to-market are whitespace. Monetization and timing validated.

findings.claim: Competitors span all 3 venues on copy/social trading, not research.
findings.evidence: FrenFlow multi-venue; pvp.trade Hyperliquid; okbet/TradePolyBot copy.

findings.claim: AI-research + podcast sourcing are whitespace; fee model validated.
findings.evidence: OctagonAI is a CLI not a bot; no bot does podcasts; ~1pct+referral; HIP-4 May 2 2026.

result.caveats: FrenFlow advertises all 3 venues via Telegram bot (parity refuted 0-3, verify one-click Kalshi/Hyperliquid exec). okbet Polymarket/Kalshi copy (first-mover/pricing refuted). pvp.trade Hyperliquid incumbent. Polymarket bots mature on paste-to-trade. AI deep research only as OctagonAI CLI; no podcast sourcing (whitespace). Trojan ~23.4B/1.7M users; markets ~23-27B Jan 2026; HIP-4 fresh. Polycule hack made non-custodial expected. GTM: lead with AI-research + podcast hook, ship non-custodial, use ~1pct+referral.
openQuestions: FrenFlow real one-click Kalshi/Hyperliquid exec and volume?

refuted.claim: FrenFlow operates a Telegram bot supporting full trading, copy trading, wallet tracking, and price alerts across Polymarket, Kalshi, Hyperliquid, and Predict.fun.
TradePolyBot reports roughly 11,000 traders and $20,000,000 in volume as of early May 2026.

The top 5 Telegram trading bots are all focused on Solana/EVM token (memecoin) trading via DEXs, not prediction markets or perps, indicating prediction-market Telegram bots are whitespace relative to this category.

The Telegram DEX trading bot sector had ~$38.4 billion in lifetime volume across all chains, with Solana accounting for ~69.5% and Ethereum ~26.7%, indicating the established Telegram-bot market is overwhelmingly spot/DEX crypto rather than prediction markets.

The leading Telegram trading bots (Banana Gun, Trojan, Maestro, BONKbot, Unibot) differentiate primarily on sniping speed, MEV/honeypot/rug protection, and revenue-share tokenomics rather than on research/discovery features, leaving AI-research and content-to-market matching as whitespace.

This directory of Polymarket trading bots lists no Kalshi or Hyperliquid Telegram bots, suggesting the Kalshi/Hyperliquid Telegram-bot niche is comparatively unpopulated as of the directory's 2026 listing.
okbet positions itself as the original (first) Telegram prediction-markets trading bot, focused primarily on Polymarket with Kalshi support added.
okbet's business model is a flat 1% (100bps) trading fee charged on every buy and sell, with no other charges.
